title: The State Is Not the Bottleneck: A Paged-State Gated-DeltaNet Tile on a Tri-Mode Multicast Mesh, Bit-Exact from RTL to Silicon
abstract: arXiv:2611.18422v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Linear-attention language models replace a growing key-value cache with a recurrent state of fixed size. On an edge FPGA, this state can exceed the on-chip memory and must be paged to external memory. This paper asks whether such paging dominates the cost of decoding (generating tokens). We built a hardware tile that computes one complete layer of a custom 369-million-parameter hybrid Gated DeltaNet model on an Agilex 5 FPGA and pages its recurrent state. The model state needs 6.2 MiB, whereas the device has 0.87 MiB of block memory. Paging adds 26.0 MB of memory traffic per decoded token, at most 11.2 percent of the calculated total. On the board at 75 MHz, with synthetic weights, one token takes 11.15 ms in this layer. The matrix-vector products with the weights take about 62 percent of this time and the state phase, including the paging, 13 percent. The tile is one node of a multicast mesh of tri-mode processing elements. We measure

translated_title: 状态并非瓶颈：三模式组播网格上具有分页状态的Gated-DeltaNet硬件单元，从RTL到硅片位级精确
translated_abstract: 线性注意力语言模型用一个固定大小的循环状态取代了不断增长的键值缓存。在边缘FPGA上，这一状态可能超出片上存储容量，必须分页到外部存储器。本文探讨这种分页是否会主导解码（生成token）的成本。我们构建了一个硬件计算单元，在Agilex 5 FPGA上计算定制的3.69亿参数混合Gated DeltaNet模型的完整一层，并对其循环状态进行分页。模型状态需要6.2 MiB，而器件仅有0.87 MiB的块存储器。分页在每个解码token增加26.0 MB的内存流量，最多占计算总量的11.2%。在75 MHz的板卡上使用合成权重时，该层处理一个token需要11.15毫秒。与权重的矩阵-向量乘法约占该时间的62%，而状态阶段（包括分页）占13%。该计算单元是三模式处理元件组播网格中的一个节点。我们测量……
tldr: 在Agilex 5 FPGA上实现的Gated-DeltaNet单层硬件单元表明，尽管循环状态需分页至片外存储，分页开销仅占解码总时间的11.2%，状态并非瓶颈，矩阵-向量乘法才是主要耗时部分。
en_tdlr: A hardware tile on an Agilex 5 FPGA computing one layer of a 369M-parameter hybrid Gated DeltaNet model demonstrates that paging the recurrent state to external memory adds at most 11.2% overhead per token, proving that state paging is not the decoding bottleneck—matrix-vector products dominate the compute time.
